intro: New here? Read top to bottom once: who Erdem is, the strategy, then the plan and the reports. After that, the weekly loop is 📑 Reports → 🗓️ Plan.

pages.title: 🏠 Dashboard
pages.why: The whole system on one page: sprint, latest videos, OKRs.

pages.title: 🧭 Expectations
pages.why: What the assistant can and cannot do for you.

pages.title: 📖 My story
pages.why: Who's behind the channel and why self-learning matters now.

pages.title: 🌸 Ikigai
pages.why: What you love, are good at, get paid for and the world needs, and where they meet.

pages.title: 🔥 My passions
pages.why: Learning from video, asking questions, and building software (612 repos).

pages.title: 🧬 Personality & conation
pages.why: OCEAN, Kolbe (Quick Start 9) and DISC (I-D), and what they mean for how you work.

pages.title: 🧠 What I care about
pages.why: AI and human intelligence, consciousness, Lacan, UML, enterprise patterns, space, RTS games.

pages.title: 🧑‍🏫 My mentors
pages.why: Who you learn from (Linus, Ali Abdaal, İlker Canıkligil, PBD, Tony Robbins, Hawkins) and what each gives the channel.

pages.title: 📜 Research: AGI, work & meaning
pages.why: Erdem's paper: what AGI does to the workforce and how people find meaning.

pages.title: 🎯 Core message
pages.why: The one idea every video points back to.

pages.title: 👥 Audience map
pages.why: Who watches: consumers, professionals, businesses.

pages.title: ⚖️ Supply & demand
pages.why: What people want versus what you can make.

pages.title: 🔁 Reverse response
pages.why: Why each video should exist and what to check.

pages.title: 💡 Inspiration
pages.why: What to borrow from Gary Stevenson and NetworkChuck, and what not to copy.

pages.title: 🌟 Creators I admire
pages.why: Nate Herk, Nate B Jones, Tina Huang, NetworkChuck, Alex Finn: their styles, mapped.

pages.title: 👏 YouTubers I applaud
pages.why: Sabine Hossenfelder, Dr. Todd Grande: high value, low production.

pages.title: 🔭 Similar niche channels
pages.why: Paste links to similar YouTube channels and note what to borrow.

pages.title: ⭐ Early stars
pages.why: Small AI channels whose video got 5× more views than subs, and a scan to find more.

pages.title: 🎒 AI course sellers
pages.why: How AI course sellers pitch, price and prove results, with a sample sales page.

pages.title: 🎨 Formats I like
pages.why: Line animation, an animated co-host, comics, comedy and a sci-fi series, made yours.

pages.title: 🏁 Subscriber goals
pages.why: 1,000 → 3,000 steps and the pace needed.

pages.title: 📉 On track?
pages.why: Are the numbers keeping pace with the goals?

pages.title: 💼 Business plan
pages.why: Students free, professionals $49/month, businesses get a managed bot service.

pages.title: 🥇 My next video
pages.why: What to make next, and why, from all the data.

pages.title: 🎬 Planned videos
pages.why: Every planned video, its hook and target.

pages.title: 💎 Value check
pages.why: Is each planned video genuinely useful?

pages.title: 📅 Calendar view
pages.why: The plan laid out by day.

pages.title: ⛔ Blocked days
pages.why: Days you can't film or publish.

pages.title: 📅 Weekly Direction Report
pages.why: Planned vs published, and whether you're on course.

pages.title: 🚀 Channel Performance Report
pages.why: What's working, what isn't, what to do next.

pages.title: 🧾 Quarterly Report
pages.why: The quarter in numbers and the pace to the subscriber goal.

pages.title: ✅ What works / ⛔ what doesn't
pages.why: The two pillars to grow, and the formats to stop, with the evidence.

pages.why: Raw stats, Studio snapshot and data gaps.

pages.why: YouTube, LinkedIn, X and Skool in one place.

pages.why: What Claude needs from you to do more.

pages.why: Where the secrets live and how they are used.

pages.why: Status of the scheduled stats job.
